map.常用 8-16 mmol/L（因公式与单位而异）；升高提示乳酸/酮体/尿毒症等未: Commonly 8-16 mmol/L (depending on the formula and the unit); a rise points to an increase in unmeasured anions such as lactate, ketones or uraemia.
map.提示白球比倒置，常见于肝病、肾病、营养不良或慢性炎症；但需看 Alb 与 Glo: An inverted albumin/globulin ratio suggests liver disease, kidney disease, malnutrition or chronic inflammation, but you also need the individual Alb and Glob values and their trends.

map.肝病随访算白球比 A/G，辅助判断合成功能趋势。: For liver disease follow-up, compute the albumin/globulin ratio A/G to help judge synthetic function trends.
map.肾功能/甲旁亢算钙磷乘积，评估异位钙化风险。: For kidney function or hyperparathyroidism, compute the calcium-phosphorus product to assess ectopic calcification risk.
map.计算 AST/ALT(De Ritis)、BUN/Cr 等肝肾功能比值，辅助病因: Compute liver and kidney function ratios such as AST/ALT (De Ritis) and BUN/Cr to help differentiate causes
